To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the relationship between frustration and expectancy disconfirmation is moderated by the gaming intensity of online gamers.
frustration does not reduce the continuance intention of online gamers when the expectancy disconfirmation is high and the gaming intensity of the gamer is high.
frustration reduces continuance intention of online gamers only if the gamers are highly intense in their gaming.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to reduce frustration in order to enhance continuance intention of gamers.
the question: When does frustration not reduce continuance intentions of online gamers?
the effects of game challenge on continuance intention of gamers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the negative relationship between frustration and expectancy disconfirmation is moderated by the gaming intensity and expectancy disconfirmation positively relates to continuance intention.
frustration does not reduce the continuance intention of online gamers who have a long gaming history, but it does reduce continuance intention of those with a high gaming frequency.
the expectancy disconfirmation perspective can help online game providers to design games that are challenging and still maintain the continuance intention of online gamers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
game designers can design games with high challenge and low frustration by designing the game to be highly challenging, yet still easy to win.
frustration does not reduce the continuance intention of online gamers when the expectancy disconfirmation is high.
frustration can be reduced when game providers provide a challenging gaming environment for online gamers with a high level of gaming intensity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the relationship between frustration and expectancy disconfirmation is not linear but rather curvilinear, i.e., frustration does not reduce expectancy disconfirmation when it exceeds a certain level.
frustration is not necessarily a bad thing for gamers.
frustration can have positive effects on the continuance intention of online gamers.
